d: Salmon-pink hair is styled in a high ponytail with choppy bangs and loose strands framing the face. Sharp, narrow lime-green eyes peer through round black-rimmed glasses on a youthful face with a tired expression. A slender build is dressed in a blue t-shirt, short black shorts, and a long white lab coat, accented by a brown leather belt holding a blue soda can and a black lanyard with an ID badge. Signature details include a panda-themed coffee mug, white calf-high socks, and plush panda-shaped slippers.
